Celebrating Paradise Gourmet Rewards’ 15th Anniversary

Paradise Teochew | Seafood Paradise | Beauty in The Pot | Paradise Dynasty | Canton Paradise | Paradise Classic

Thank you for your unwavering support, loyalty and love for great food over the past 15 years.

In celebration of Paradise Gourmet Rewards’ 15th Anniversary, all Silver and Gold Members will receive three exclusive e-vouchers, each redeemable with a minimum spend at participating restaurants.

Existing Silver and Gold Members will receive the e-vouchers in their membership accounts on 1 September 2026.

Not a Silver Member yet? Sign up or upgrade to Silver Member by 31 October 2026, and the e-vouchers will be credited to your account at 6am the following day.

Redeem your e-vouchers from 1 September to 22 November 2026, and celebrate 15 rewarding years with more delicious dining experiences.

Participating Restaurants for E-voucher Redemption:

  • Paradise Teochew: Braised Sliced Irish Fat Duck (Half) (worth $55) with min. spend of $100
  • Seafood Paradise: Stewed Curry Fish Head in Claypot (worth $48.80) with min. spend of $50
  • Beauty in The Pot: Strengthening Ginseng Kampong Chicken Broth (Twin Pot) (worth $16.90) with min. spend of $80
  • Paradise Dynasty: Spicy Szechuan Seafood Pot (worth $38.80) with min. spend of $40
  • Canton Paradise: Roasted Dang Gui Irish Fat Duck (Regular) (worth $22.80) with min. spend of $40
  • Paradise Classic: Deep-fried Marble Goby with Supreme Soya Sauce (worth $38.80) with min. spend of $40

Terms and Conditions

  • Redemption of e-vouchers are valid till 22 Nov 2026 for dine-in by active Silver and Gold Paradise Gourmet Rewards members only, while stocks last.
  • Redemption is valid for listed items at respective restaurants, excluding Paradise Dynasty (Funan) and Canton Paradise (ION Orchard, Marina Bay Sands and VivoCity) restaurants.
  • Valid daily at Seafood Paradise (CQ @ Clarke Quay), Paradise Dynasty (Suntec City and VivoCity) and Canton Paradise (City Square Mall) restaurants, including public holidays.
  • Valid from Mondays to Fridays after 5pm, and all-day on weekends at Canton Paradise (Alexandra Retail Centre) and Paradise Classic (Marina Bay Link Mall) restaurants, including public holidays.
  • Valid from Mondays to Fridays, 11.30am to 4.30pm, at Beauty in The Pot (The Centrepoint) restaurant, excluding public holidays.
  • Valid all-day from Mondays to Fridays at all other participating restaurants, excluding public holidays.
  • Redemption is valid at Paradise Teochew for Braised Sliced Irish Fat Duck (Half) with a min. spend of $100; at Seafood Paradise for Stewed Curry Fish Head in Claypot with a min. spend of $50; at Beauty in The Pot for Strengthening Ginseng Kampong Chicken Broth (Twin Pot) with a min. spend of $80; at Paradise Dynasty for Spicy Szechuan Seafood Pot with a min. spend of $40; at Canton Paradise for Roasted Dang Gui Irish Fat Duck (Regular) with a min. spend of $40; and at Paradise Classic for Deep-fried Marble Goby with Supreme Soya Sauce with a min. spend of $40.

  • Minimum spend amount and worth value are subject to service charge (dine-in) and prevailing GST.
